title: Review of Zero Vehicle Growth Policy, Vehicle Quota System and Rebates Given High COE Prices, Increased E-vehicles Adoption and Roll-out of ERP 2.0
what_it_is: Review of Zero Vehicle Growth Policy, Vehicle Quota System and Rebates Given High COE Prices, Increased E-vehicles Adoption and Roll-out of ERP 2.0

sections.label: Additional COEs from February 2025
sections.summary: LTA announced it will inject up to about 20,000 additional COEs from February 2025 across vehicle categories over the next few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The first is in relation to the Land Transport Authority's (LTA’s) recent announcement that it will inject up to about 20,000 additional Certificates of Entitlement (COEs) from February 2025, across the different vehicle categories over the next few years.

sections.label: Travel patterns and traffic demand
sections.summary: LTA said travel patterns evolved after COVID-19, total vehicle mileage fell about 6% from 2019 to 2023, and city cordon ERP gantries remain un-activated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As LTA explained when it announced the move to inject up to about 20,000 COEs, travel patterns have evolved after the COVID-19 pandemic and total vehicle mileage decreased by around 6% from 2019 to 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We have also observed lower traffic demand in the central business district (CBD) and ERP gantries in the city cordon remain un-activated.

sections.label: ERP 2.0 and COE injection
sections.summary: LTA assessed ERP 2.0 tools let it inject up to about 20,000 additional COEs from February 2025 without traffic gridlock, about 2% of the vehicle population.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: With ERP 2.0, LTA will have more tools and better capabilities to manage traffic congestion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: ERP 2.0 will provide more comprehensive aggregated traffic information.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: It will also enable LTA to more quickly introduce new “virtual gantries” where necessary, based on the latest traffic patterns.

Given these considerations, LTA assessed that it will be able to inject up to about 20,000 additional COEs across the vehicle categories from February 2025 over the next few years, without the worries of causing traffic gridlock.
Twenty thousand additional COEs are about 2% of our total vehicle population.
We had earlier said that the COE quota for Categories A, B and C will continue to increase every quarter before reaching the projected peak supply from 2026.

sections.label: Distance-based charging and COEs
sections.summary: Distance-based charging would give LTA another congestion tool, with scope to consider further COE injection alongside its implementation.

sentences.text: If we were to proceed with distance-based charging in future, this will give LTA an additional tool to manage congestion and there is scope to consider a further injection of additional COEs in tandem with the implementation of distance-based charging.

sections.label: COE supply and prices
sections.summary: All else being equal, an increase in COE supply should help to moderate prices.

sentences.text: All else being equal, an increase in COE supply should help to moderate prices.

sections.label: PQP falls and resident bids
sections.summary: Prevailing Quota Premiums fell across all vehicle categories by about 4% to 21% over the past year, and Singapore Residents rose from 66% in 2022 to 84% of successful Cat A and B bids.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Members may also access the handout through the MP@SGPARL App.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, Mr Speaker, if we, first, refer to Table 1, the Prevailing Quota Premiums (PQP), which is the average COE price over the past three months and the price which vehicle owners pay to renew their COEs, have fallen across all vehicle categories, by about 4% to 21% over the past year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: If we, now, look at the breakdown of successful Cat A and B bids from 2022 to Oct 2024 in Table 2, Singapore Residents account for the large majority of successful bids, increasing from 66% in 2022 to 84% this year.

sections.label: COE price increase drivers
sections.summary: Data show recent COE price increases are likely driven mainly by strong demand from local individual buyers, not foreigners or car leasing companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The data show that the main drivers for the increase in COE prices in recent quarters are likely due to strong demand from local individual buyers and not from foreigners or car leasing companies.

sections.label: Electric car tax rebates
sections.summary: The option is still being carefully assessed, and up to $40,000 in tax rebates is currently provided for electric cars.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, we are still carefully assessing this option.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We currently provide up to $40,000 in tax rebates for electric cars.

sections.label: Cat A power rating threshold
sections.summary: In 2022, the power rating threshold for Cat A cars was increased to right-site mass-market electric car models.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: In 2022, we increased the power rating threshold for Cat A cars, to right-site mass-market electric car models.

sections.label: Monitoring 20,000 additional COEs
sections.summary: After progressively injecting the 20,000 COEs over a few years, monitoring will continue carefully.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my main reply, after we progressively inject the 20,000 COEs over time, this is over a few years, we will, of course, continue to monitor carefully.

sections.label: Ownership control and usage pricing
sections.summary: Combining ownership control through COE and usage-based pricing such as ERP can achieve balance between different stakeholder groups' needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: You can, through a combination of ownership control, which is what COE is, and usage-based pricing, which is, for example, ERP, achieve this balance between the needs of different stakeholder groups.

sections.label: Distance-based charging and COE supply
sections.summary: If acceptable to stakeholders, distance-based charging as an additional traffic management tool could allow greater leeway to introduce more COEs.

sentences.text: If we are able to do it in a way which can be acceptable to the stakeholders, the upside of introducing distance-based charging as an additional tool for traffic management is that we can then have greater leeway to introduce more COEs.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: First, I note that the recent announcement of the 20,000 additional COEs appear to be somewhat more aggressive than the hitherto more tentative "cut and fill" approach.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: I wonder if this move represents a more firm commitment by MOT to equalise over time, the annual COE supply, especially with regard to reducing the number of COEs available at decade-end, to eliminate the "feast and famine" volatility of COE prices.

sections.label: Adding 20,000 COEs
sections.summary: Adding about 20,000 COEs over the next few years would help reduce the peak-to-trough ratio.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: If we could add to this direction by having this additional injection of about 20,000 COEs over the next few years, I think it will certainly help to make a further step towards reducing the peak-to-trough ratio.

sections.label: ERP 2.0 and COE supply
sections.summary: With ERP 2.0 data, if congestion can be managed confidently, there is scope to increase COE supply.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Because we are already seeing that, even though we are still in the initial stages of installing ERP 2.0, we now have 150,000 to 160,000 vehicles, which is less than 20% of the total vehicle population.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, the drop in the vehicular usage is more likely linked to the changes in the usage patterns after the pandemic.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: But I agree with Assoc Prof Lim that with ERP 2.0, when we collect the data, if it shows that we are better able and more confident to manage traffic congestion and avoid gridlocks, there is scope to look at whether we can further increase the COE supply.

sections.label: COE price rise
sections.summary: The COE price in 2024 has gone higher compared to 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: So, just wondering if the Minister can elucidate on that.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: But the COE price in 2024 compared to 2022 has actually gone higher up.
